name: Google AI (Gemini API)
summary: Gemini models for text, images (Nano Banana), video (Omni), speech (TTS) and music (Lyria) through the Gemini Interactions API.
notes: Generation of every kind goes through POST /v1beta/interactions with a different model and response_format; the docs call the older generateContent API legacy.
Media comes back base64-encoded inside the JSON, so responses are large.
Model names change quickly; list the current ones with google-ai.models.list.
Prices differ by model; see the pricing page.

endpoints.name: Generate or edit an image (Nano Banana)
endpoints.summary: Text-to-image, and image editing when the input includes images, with a Gemini image model.

model.description: Image model: gemini-nano-banana-2.1, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3-pro-image or the legacy gemini-2.5-flash-image.

input.description: The prompt (an array of typed parts, such as {"type":"text"} and {"type":"image","data":base64,"mime_type"}, is also accepted).
input.example: A nano banana dish in a fancy restaurant

previous_interaction_id.description: Id of an earlier interaction to continue editing from.

Api_Revision.description: API revision pin used in the docs' REST examples.

notes: Calls the Interactions API, the docs' default; the legacy generateContent API still works but is described as legacy.
The reply is JSON with a steps array; generated media is base64 in steps[].content[].data of the model_output step with the matching type (the convenience properties like output_image are SDK-only).
Synchronous: the image comes back in the same response. Every image carries a SynthID watermark.

endpoints.name: Generate a video (Gemini Omni Flash)
endpoints.summary: Text, image or video to a 3 to 15 second video with native audio.

input.example: A marble rolling fast on a chain reaction style track.

response_format.description: e.g. {"type":"video","aspect_ratio":"9:16"}; supported ratios are 9:16 and 16:9, default resolution 720p.

previous_interaction_id.description: Id of an earlier interaction to refine or extend a video.

notes: Calls the Interactions API, the docs' default; the legacy generateContent API still works but is described as legacy.
The reply is JSON with a steps array; generated media is base64 in steps[].content[].data of the model_output step with the matching type (the convenience properties like output_image are SDK-only).
Synchronous: the docs show the finished video (mp4, base64) in the same response with status completed; there is no separate polling call.
Veo 3.1 preview models were shut down on 22 October 2026; use Gemini Omni Flash.

endpoints.name: Generate speech (Gemini TTS)
endpoints.summary: Text-to-speech with a prebuilt or custom voice, steered by style annotations.

generation_config.description: Voice choice: {"speech_config":[{"voice":"Kore"}]}; for several speakers see speech_config.speakers in the docs.

notes: Calls the Interactions API, the docs' default; the legacy generateContent API still works but is described as legacy.
The reply is JSON with a steps array; generated media is base64 in steps[].content[].data of the model_output step with the matching type (the convenience properties like output_image are SDK-only).
Synchronous; the audio is base64 WAV in the response.
Extended and custom voices are listed with google-ai.voices.list.

endpoints.name: Generate music (Lyria)
endpoints.summary: Instrumental or vocal music from a text prompt or an image.

model.description: lyria-3-clip-preview (30-second clips) or lyria-3.5 (full songs, a couple of minutes).

input.description: Description of the music, optionally with lyrics and structure.
input.example: A short instrumental acoustic guitar piece.

Api_Revision.description: API revision pin used in the docs' REST examples.

notes: Calls the Interactions API, the docs' default; the legacy generateContent API still works but is described as legacy.
The reply is JSON with a steps array; generated media is base64 in steps[].content[].data of the model_output step with the matching type (the convenience properties like output_image are SDK-only).
Output is 44.1 kHz stereo MP3; the response also includes the lyrics and song structure as text.
Real-time streaming music (Lyria RealTime) uses a websocket and is not covered.

endpoints.name: Ask a Gemini model (text)
endpoints.summary: A text answer from a Gemini model through the Interactions API.
notes: Calls the Interactions API, the docs' default; the legacy generateContent API still works but is described as legacy.
Billed per token by model.
